# Retired catalogue detection workflow

The former `.github/workflows/detect-changes.yml` has no active replacement.
Scheduled and manual triggers, jobs, credentials and write permissions have been
removed. This record is outside the Actions workflow directory and is not executable.

The legacy `scripts/detect-changes.ts` is retained for history and its unconditional
fail-closed guard remains unchanged. Its unreachable catalogue-update implementation
must not be enabled. No publication, correction or archive automation is authorised.
An audited replacement requires human D4 approval and separate security review.
The original workflow remains available in Git history at f266acdc.
